definitions.explanation: People who share a common purpose or interest and voluntarily come together for a cause or activity. Implies willing participation rather than obligation.

examples.japanese: {有志|ゆうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募|つの}って→募る：10878_tsunoru⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{企画|きかく}した→企画する：29396_kikakusuru⟧。
examples.english: We recruited volunteers and planned an event.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{有志|ゆうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{清掃|せいそう}→清掃：04332_seisou⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Volunteer employees carried out a cleanup activity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{有志|ゆうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まって→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧、{子|こ}どもたち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学習|がくしゅう}→学習：02623_gakushuu⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦プログラム→プログラム：01540_puroguramu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}げた→立ち上げる：07892_tachiageru⟧。
examples.english: Local volunteers came together and launched a learning support program for children.

notes:
USAGE:
Used to describe people who voluntarily participate in something. Often appears in the pattern {有志|ゆうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募|つの}る→募る：10878_tsunoru⟧ (to recruit volunteers) or {有志|ゆうし}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧ (by volunteers). More formal than ⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧ and emphasizes shared purpose rather than unpaid labor.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {有志|ゆうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募|つの}る→募る：10878_tsunoru⟧: to recruit volunteers
- {有志|ゆうし}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧: by volunteers, volunteer-run
- {有志|ゆうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧: volunteers gather
- {有志|ゆうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧: a group of interested parties

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧: volunteer (loanword, broader)
- ⟦{志願者|しがんしゃ}→志願者：20919_shigansha⟧: volunteer, applicant (formal)
